primer.title: Why Coastal Quotes Vary So Much
primer.subtitle: Fairhope's average premium runs more than double Alabama's on the same $350K dwelling (ValuePenguin, Sep 2026).

cards.label: WIND VS NON-WIND
cards.body: Coastal policies split wind/hurricane from all other perils. Wind is most of the premium here and carries its own percentage deductible.

cards.label: THREE MARKETS, ONE HOUSE
cards.body: Baldwin risks place three ways: admitted carriers, surplus lines, or the AIUA wind pool. Surplus lines adds 6% AL tax, ~25% minimum earned premium, and no guaranty fund.

cards.label: MITIGATION IS THE LEVER
cards.body: Alabama law requires insurers to discount FORTIFIED-certified homes. A 5-yr roof may qualify for a FORTIFIED Roof evaluation. Ask for the credit in dollars.

cards.label: DEFAULTS ARE EXPENSIVE
cards.body: Agents quote conservative defaults when you specify nothing. This brief makes every quote come back on the same spec.

primer.source_note: Sources: ValuePenguin Alabama homeowners study (Sep 2026); ALDOI; Strengthen Alabama Homes rules 482-1-159 (eff. Jan 2026).

agent_script.title: Work the Script
agent_script.subtitle: Questions that separate a good policy from a cheap-looking one.
questions: Is the wind deductible triggered by 'named storm,' 'hurricane,' or 'wind/hail'? Show me the definition page.
What roof age did you rate? I'll send the permit; requote if you used 1992.
Is roof settlement replacement cost, ACV, or a payment schedule by age?
What FORTIFIED credit applies if I certify the roof, in dollars on THIS quote?
Admitted or surplus lines? If surplus: minimum earned premium, fully earned fees, guaranty-fund status?
What is the total walk-out cost: premium plus every fee plus surplus lines tax?
What does the same policy cost with 1% and 5% wind deductibles?
Will the exterior wood repairs (siding, porch, trim) affect binding? What do you need documented?
red_flags: Dwelling coverage well below the $500K estimate. Underinsurance disguised as savings.
RCV roof on the summary page but an age-triggered ACV roof form in the endorsements. Read the forms schedule.
Roof rated at 1992 because no permit was supplied.
No wind deductible dollar figure shown, only a percentage.
Flood 'included' claims. Homeowners policies exclude flood.
A quote delivered without a single question asked about the property.
agent_script.footer_note: A quote you can't compare is a quote you can't trust.
